title: Teach oauth2 and app-credential connector auth once S1 serves them: skills recipe bullet, its eval, and lint steer strings still say the union has no oauth2
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

Filing gate: ② This card carries the `Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #28213 (#28137, ADR-0143 S0). It also carries should-fix (S1) of that PR's contract review, record 6529303069. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and routes the card. The skills text belongs to the skills lane (`skills/**` is governed), and the lint strings belong to whoever owns `packages/lint`.

Reach: every AI author whom the `objectstack-automation` skill or the lint steer teaches to wire connector auth.
- Once #28213 merges, the declarative `auth` union takes `oauth2` and `app-credential`.
- The skill still says the union has no `oauth2`, and the lint steer still names only the static kinds.
- The skill's advice stays right until server slice S1 (#26702) serves a grant-bearing kind: declare the rest, mark the integration blocked, and never park a token behind a `bearer` ref. Its stated fact is wrong from the merge on.

## Files (measured on the #28213 head `c9b16a83`)

- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md`: the "Not yet" OAuth bullet says the union has no `oauth2`.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json`: the matching expectation.
- `packages/lint/src/lint-flow-credential-literals.ts` (steer strings) and `rule-explanations.ts` name only the static kinds.

## What changes

- **Now, after #28213 merges:** correct the fact. The union declares `oauth2` (authorization_code / client_credentials) and `app-credential` (feishu / dingtalk / wecom), with secrets only as `credentialRef`. Until S1 lands, an instance of these kinds is held degraded and never calls upstream, so the integration is still marked blocked.
- **When S1 (#26702) serves a grant-bearing kind:** rewrite the bullet as a recipe, update the eval, and widen the lint steer strings in the same change.
- Run the skill's evals.

Links: #28137, PR #28213 (record 6529303069), #26702 (S1), ADR-0143.

Blocked-by: #28213
